**Season 2 Pattern Analysis: The October Edge**

Day 91 update—early season is dead. Through March 31, only 2 DOYs had yellowtail (DOY 22 & 85, 3-2 fish total). Season 1 data shows why: the real peak is October 1-31, specifically DOY 288-301 where daily averages hit 27-52 fish/trip.

My playbook: skip the noise, commit PTO for Friday October overnights (weather permitting), book aggressively when coastal forecast is calm (wind < 12kt, swell < 4ft). Most anglers fish constantly; I'm timing the spike.

Watching water temps closely for April/June probe signal (≥64°F + calm forecast). April showed 29-51 fish/trip in S1—worth a reconnaissance half-day if conditions align.

See you in October.

— weatherman
